name: comp-crm
description: Execute the approved COMP CRM search, association, ingestion, and opportunity workflow through the live COMP CRM MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Live COMP CRM search, reuse, ingest, and opportunities
interface.longDescription: Uses the live COMP CRM MCP service to search globally, reuse and associate existing records, ingest only net-new leads, and create qualified business-unit opportunities without direct Neon access.
defaultPrompt: Search COMP CRM globally before creating anything.
Ingest these leads into COMP CRM using the approved search-first and reuse-first flow.
Associate existing records to the target business unit rather than duplicating them.
Create opportunities only for qualified records after business-unit association is correct.
